Normal (Version 1) }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Robloxia''' was a [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]]-exclusive [[Maps|map]] during [[Hardcore Testing BETA]] that resembled the artistic style of blocky Roblox houses common in 2009. It was also once a regular map when it was first added. ==Design & Path== {{Tabber |Version 2 |The second version of '''Robloxia''' was a large town on an island surrounded by water. There were many hills of different colors to symbolize the diversity of the map. One part of the map appeared to be in winter, another in autumn and another in spring. There were many houses, trees and buildings to represent a thriving town. Skyscrapers with a high walkway could be seen in the autumn area of the map. Cliffs surrounded the houses in the town. Two water sources could also be seen in the town. Advertisement boards advertising old Roblox could also be found around the map. A larger house can also be seen on the outskirts of the town. The black studded path began at a cave in one of the hills and ended at a cave near the autumn area after going beneath the skyscraper walkway. It twisted around the mountains, taking many corners, not taking a direct route to the end of the map. |Version 1 |The first version of '''Robloxia''' was a large town in the middle of a grass plain. There were many hills of different colors to symbolize the diversity of the map. One part of the map appeared to be in winter, another in autumn and another in spring. There were many houses, trees and buildings to represent a thriving town. Skyscrapers with a high walkway could be seen in the autumn area of the map. Cliffs surrounded the houses in the town. Two water sources could also be seen in the town. Advertisement boards advertising old Roblox could also be found around the map. A larger house can also be seen on the outskirts of the town. Various eggs could also be seen throughout the map. The black studded path began at a cave in one of the hills and ended at a cave near the autumn area after going beneath the skyscraper walkway. It twisted around the mountains, taking many corners, not taking a direct route to the end of the map. }} ==Strategy== *The cliffs that run alongside the path near the entrance are ideal for placing cliff towers, like the [[Ranger|Outlaw]] and [[Mortar]], as they can reach a large part of the map from here. **If you want to maximize cliff space, try stacking your towers. **Long-range towers, such as the [[Turret]], can also reach a long distance near this spot. **As such, a well placed [[DJ Booth]] and [[Commander]] can boost a huge number of towers. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Map Icons}} Robloxia.png|First version (14 June 2019 – 13 October 2019) {{GalleryHeader|View}} Roblox.png|First version (14 June 2019 – 13 October 2019) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} OldThumb.png|First version on the game thumbnail. }} ==Trivia== *There were a few Easter eggs that could be seen on the first version of this map, but not on the second version. **All the eggs from the [[w:c:roblox:Eggstravaganza|ROBLOX Egg Hunt 2008]] could be found around the map. **There was a [[wp:JoJo's Bizarre Adventure|JoJo's Bizarre Adventure]] decal found on the map. *A noob could be seen watching TV in the large house on this map. **The decal on the TV screen was taken from [[w:c:madnesscombat:Nevada|Madness Combat]] saying "''Somewhere in Nevada''". *This map was removed in the [[Release v1.0|MEGA Update]], being one of the maps that was not remade. **This map briefly returned for [[Hardcore Testing BETA]], but it was not added in the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]], most likely for the map being too easy. == Update History == *'''14 June 2019''' - [[BETA v1.0|BETA v1.0.0]] **'''Robloxia''' added. *'''5 August 2019''' - [[BETA v1.8|BETA v1.8.0]] **{{Color|OldNormal}} difficulty removed. *'''13 October 2019''' - [[Release v1.0|Release v1.0.0]] **'''Robloxia''' removed. *'''28 August 2020''' - [[Hardcore Testing BETA]] **'''Robloxia''' remade and re-added. *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]] **'''Robloxia''' removed. {{MapNavBox}}
